conventions.near_degenerate_description: Two principal moments flagged if within this fraction of each other.
conventions.sign_ambiguous_description: Flagged when the top-2 largest-projection atoms on any axis are within this relative tolerance -- the sign convention becomes numerically unstable under rotation in this case.
conventions.sign_convention_rule: For each principal axis, the atom with largest |projection| is forced positive.
conventions.reflection_rule: If the resulting rotation matrix has det(V) < 0 (a reflection, not a proper rotation), axis 2 is flipped to restore det(V) = +1 and preserve molecular chirality.
